subject: Follow-up: Finlytics discovery — hyperscaler fit + OpenAI-compatible test plan
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Robert Lang <robert.lang@finlytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: Finlytics discovery — hyperscaler fit + OpenAI-compatible test plan

Hi Robert — thanks again for the quick demo today. High-level recap and proposed next steps so we have a single plan to run against your engineers this week.

Recap (what I took away)
- Primary driver: move inference off your internal cluster to reduce ops overhead while keeping token costs predictable.
- Key constraints: streaming latency under 150ms p50 for 2k-context scoring flows; model-output parity with current OpenAI responses for our core reranker and summarization prompts; SOC 2 evidence and contractual SLAs.
- Risk flags you called out: SDK/API surface differences (batching/streaming), prompt tokenization subtle diffs, and model artifact parity (quantization/float mismatch).

Proposed evaluation plan (concrete tests)
1) API compatibility smoke (2 dev days): hit a Redwood OpenAI-compat endpoint with your current SDK wrapper — verify 1:1 call shape, streaming frames, error codes.
2) Prompt-diff run (bench): run 200 representative prompts (mix: rerank, summarize, chat) through OpenAI and Redwood-compat endpoints; compare tokenization, first-token distributions, and full-response BLEU/ROUGE deltas.
3) Latency parity test: 50 concurrent connections, 2k context, p50/p95/p99 target capture. Run on Dedicated and Hosted fallbacks.
4) SDK swap checklist: small PR for your client wrapper with example swap diff + CI test.

Deliverables we’ll provide
- Test harness repo and instructions (Docker image + sample harness)
- Pre-filled evaluation matrix (attached)
- SOC2 summary + pointer to security questionnaire if you want deeper evidence

Timeline suggestion
- Wednesday: share test harness + Drive folder (we will)
- Thursday-Friday: your engineers run smoke tests and prompt-diff batch (we can help remote pair)
- Monday (next week): sync to review results and decisions on a pilot.

Questions for you
- Can your eng team allocate 4–6 hours across two days to run the harness?
- Any hard constraints on deployment region or egress (we noted US-only initially)?

Attachments: finlytics_eval_matrix.xlsx, redwood_hyperscaler_comparison_summary.pdf

Thanks — happy to adjust.

— Diego Fernandez
Business Development, Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Robert Lang <robert.lang@finlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2026 17:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Finlytics discovery — hyperscaler fit + OpenAI-compatible test plan

Quick notes from an SRE/Bench perspective — I sketched a minimal set of additions to Diego's plan so the team can make an apples-to-apples call: 

- Tokenization parity: include tokenizer hashes + sample token streams for the 200 prompts so we can pinpoint if differences are pre- or post-tokenization.
- KV cache behavior: add a 20-request rolling-cache test for the reranker path to observe cache hit patterns and memory growth under quantized kernels.
- Quantization permutation check: run one sample model in int8 path and record top-5 token probabilities to show divergence bounds.
- Hyperscaler delta: add a quick cost-run (50k tokens) on both the hyperscaler-managed endpoint and Redwood hosted to show 7-day extrapolated monthly cost at your observed QPS.

I can prep the harness tweaks today — will drop a branch to the Drive folder and flag the exact commands. 

— Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood
From: Robert Lang <robert.lang@finlytics.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Susan Park <susan.park@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Finlytics discovery — hyperscaler fit + OpenAI-compatible test plan

Diego / Marissa — this looks great, thanks for the clear plan. A few clarifications from our side before we kick off: 

- We can allocate two engineers (one infra, one ML infra) for the smoke + batch tests on Thu/Fri.
- Important: we will need a completed NDA (legal will sign) and a SOC2 artifact before any pilot. Can you send the SOC2 point-in-time cert + PIAs?
- Pricing: can you ballpark committed monthly spend tiers for Dedicated vs hosted? We need a number to model into the procurement request.
- Also: Susan from Acme is joining as an integration partner — she’ll help validate the marketplace flow if we move forward.

If you can send the harness and NDA today we’ll prioritize the run.

Thanks — Robert
CTO, Finlytics
robert.lang@finlytics.com
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Robert Lang <robert.lang@finlytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Finlytics discovery — hyperscaler fit + OpenAI-compatible test plan

Robert — great, appreciate the quick turnaround. Next actions (I’ll own delivery):

1) NDA and SOC2 artifacts: I’ve uploaded a redacted SOC2 summary and a standard mutual NDA to the Drive link (DocuSign template also attached in related links). Expect an email invite by EOD.
2) Test harness: public repo + Docker image link in Drive; Marissa will drop the tokenizer/hash scripts and the KV cache script by EOD today.
3) Pricing ballpark: I’ll send a short pricing matrix for committed Dedicated tiers vs hosted pay-as-you-go this afternoon — will include estimated monthly cost at your projected 5M tokens.
4) Scheduling: I’ll book a 30-min handoff for Thu 10:00 AM PT to pair with your infra lead.

Ben — can you please prepare the 50k token hyperscaler vs hosted cost run and include a short CSV we can attach to the evaluation matrix?

Robert — thanks again. If you want me to loop in Solutions Engineering for a remote pairing session during tests, I’ll do that.

Cheers,
— Diego
Business Development, Redwood Inference
